source_text: myscan. v. miscan. 31 : both passages refer to St. Martin) oþþe elles on nacodre eorðan, Bl. H. 227, II. II b. add;-- Nú miht þú wel witan þæt weorc sprecan swíðor þonne þá nacodon word þe nabbað náne fremminge, Æ-acute;lfc. T. Grn. 21, 24. II d. of a narrative, bare, without amplification or comment:-- Seó bóc is swíþe deóp gástlíce tó understandenne, and wé ne wrítaþ ná máre búton þá nacedan gerecednisse; þonne þincþ þám ungelǽredum þ-bar; eall þ-bar; andgit beó belocen on þáre ánfealdan gerecednisse, Ælfc. Gen. Thw. 2, 30. v. healf-nacod.
